adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the Table 1 activity matrix, reconciled linked database rows against primary locators, corrected mechanism overclaims to phenotype/SAR evidence, and closed the prior targeted rework ticket with explicit nonblocking material gaps.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/Table 1 and packet database rows are sufficient for source-reviewed acceptance with cautions; absent exact inactive upper bounds and prior Bacillus primary row are documented as nonblocking obtainable-only gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP inactive rows for CtetP 1 now match primary Table 1 cells; DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP broad or prior-literature annotations remain explicit source_conflict/database_only cautions rather than source_verified current-paper assay rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered all Table 1 MIC/IC50 cells for CtetP 1-4 and controls, retaining inactive markers and units without inventing missing upper-bound concentrations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 corrected automated mechanism notes to no-direct-mechanism plus phenotype/SAR-level claims supported by Table 1 and structure-activity discussion.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains after bounded source review; remaining uncertainties are explicit nonblocking cautions and no concrete rework target remains open.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP broad activity or prior-literature rows are not promoted to current-paper source_verified assay values; record-level statuses preserve the conflict/database-only distinction.
Table 1 inactive markers are retained as primary-source markers; exact maximum tested concentrations for those cells are not locally reported.
Mechanism layer is phenotype/SAR-level only; no direct target or membrane/cell-wall/immune mechanism assay is claimed.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Table 1 uses inactive markers for several MIC/IC50 cells and the local XML/PDF/supplement text does not report the tested maximum concentration for those cells.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Inactive rows retain the primary table marker and are not normalized to numeric MIC/IC50 values.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The methods identify Pseudomonas aeruginosa as a MIC target but do not give a strain/accession in the local article or supplement text.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: P. aeruginosa rows use strain=not_reported while preserving source-supported species and values.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The current 2015 local article cites prior Bacillus subtilis activity for cyclo(GSPE) but does not contain the older paper's exact 25 ug/mL primary assay row; that value remains database/prior-literature context only.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: dbAMP/CAMP prior Bacillus subtilis MIC is not promoted to a source_verified current-paper row.
